digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure / CI wall-clock assertion detector
propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock time assertions in tests cause CI flake under runner contention and must be detected and escaped via hang-guard markers or skipif-CI perf-lane guards.

Detector must block new unescaped upper-bound wall-clock asserts in tests/** with a teaching message naming both escape mechanisms, and must not flag bare @pytest.mark.benchmark markers without skipif-CI guards as passing.

Two migration sites (test_config_perf.py:201, test_enrich_drain.py:261) must replace upper-bound timing asserts with counting-proxy spies (config._ordered_layers walk count, Q.pending_enrichment probe count) verified by regression-simulation companion tests.
Remaining 11 in-scope upper-bound sites must carry reasoned hang-guard marker escapes; detector must be self-excluding and run clean on the tree at landing.
